note: The closest thing in this batch to the ICP as stated on live calls. He manages a group of companies employing around 400 people, confirmed the spend is available rather than absent ('No, no, it's possible'), and framed the goal in the ICP's own language — 'I really want to take everything to a higher level, I want to go a step above.' He is emphatically not deconditioned at 11-12% body fat with visible abs. The one criterion he fails, he fails upward: health is not his neglected area, it is his hobby — 'I don't feel good when I don't go to the gym.' That matters commercially, because the programme has to beat a functioning self-directed routine rather than fill a vacuum, and it is the reason his objection was value-comparison rather than capacity.
